title: Highly recommended with great driver and guide.
text: We had an excellent day trip to visit Alhambra and surrounding area.  We were picked up at our cruise ship in a comfortable van with a very knowledgeable driver Liam.  We were dropped off at Alhambra and met our very capable guide Emilio who gave an excellent tour and detailed history of the Alhambra buildings and grounds.
author: LA_Andrew

title: Best way to see the...
text: Best way to see the Alhambra is definitely with a private tour. It's more personal and much easier than with a large group.
author: alanrlevy

title: Perfect Tour to Experience Granada
text: This was our first time in Granada and we actually arrived via cruise ship in Motril. Our driver Carlos was waiting for us right when we walked off and then began the drive to Granada. Upon arriving in Granada we were greeted immediately by our guide Emilio who was so incredibly nice! We spent about 3hrs with Emilio learning all the history behind La Alhambra. Emilio was also kind enough to be our personal photographer as well as took so amazing photos of our entire group in all the best locations.
